objective: Validate the relaxed strict contract on the four swapping papers, then test the accepted wildcard B1 query under the same complete-set reconciliation.

supersedes.reason: Pilot 011 stopped before Search when short EID key events lacked exact Monaco readback in strict mode. The adapter now uses one target-scoped browser text-entry event for every nonempty query.

strict_contract.order_handling: Retain both ordered hashes and the changed-position count. Order equality is audit evidence and is not a membership-completeness gate.

acceptance_checks: Each event completes two exhaustive passes with equal stable-ID sets.
Each v2 receipt retains both pass-order hashes and an order-difference count.
The swapping-paper event returns exactly its four requested IDs.
The B1 event returns 165 unique IDs unless the live source total has changed explicitly.
Every successful JSON has both mandatory sibling screenshots.
stop_rules: Stop after the first failed or invalid event.
Do not retry or infer a set from a null-total failure.
